insights.text: addyosmani/agent-skills (GitHub #1, 74,606 stars) and obra/superpowers (#9, 250,072 stars) are two independently-authored agent-skill frameworks that converged on nearly identical lifecycle-phase content (define/plan/build/test/review/ship) and the same distribution channel — Anthropic's official Claude plugin marketplace — without any acquisition between them.

Grok 4.5 launched publicly at $2/M input and $6/M output tokens, undercutting Opus 4.7 ($5/$25) and OpenAI Sol ($5/$30) by 2.5-5x. Musk claims near-Opus capability, but an independent same-week build-off (TryAI) found Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 were the only two models to render a correct 3D cube on first try, while Grok 4.5 needed a retry.

GLM-5.2 (753B MoE, REAP-pruned to 469B, NVFP4-quantized) scores 81.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, up from GLM-5.1's 63.5 — a 17.5-point jump in one version, now within 3.6 points of GPT-5.5's 84.0. Every documented deployment requires 3-4 networked DGX Spark nodes (~$9-16k), not a single consumer machine.

Fox Corp is acquiring Roku for $22B (announced June 15, closing expected H1 2027) — bundling Fox's linear/news/sports content and Tubi with Roku's CTV platform, Roku Channel, and 100M+-household first-party data. Content company buying the distribution gateway, inverted from the 2015-2020 telco-buys-content pattern.

A new benchmark (Institutional Red-Teaming, IABench-CA, 33,924 games) shows deployment rules — not model choice — causally shift multi-agent safety outcomes by 22-58 percentage points. Simply naming the affected party in a consequence-allocation rule raised targeted elimination of less-resourced agents from 22% to 81%.
OpenAI released new voice models supporting simultaneous speak-and-listen live conversation, closing the turn-taking latency gap that has been the weak point of AI voice agents.

Google Play's top-30 chart is materially unchanged for a third straight day — no privacy-positioned app has entered the top 30. The Play Catalog Access opt-out deadline (third-party US store syndication) is now 13 days away (July 22, 2026).

iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI (GitHub #7, +1,717/day) packages the Office suite (docs/sheets/slides) as a CLI purpose-built for AI-agent read/write access — the CLI-as-agent-surface pattern extending from creative media into office documents.

takeaway.text: Two independent agent-skill frameworks converged on the same lifecycle content and distribution channel without any acquisition, Grok 4.5 undercuts Opus on price but not yet on independently-verified capability, and Fox's $22B Roku buy previews content companies acquiring the CTV distribution gateway instead of the other way around.
